id.name: List.Vector.get_one
id.content:
lemma get_one {α : Type*} {n} (v : Vector α (n + 2)) : v.get 1 = v.tail.head := by
  rw [←Vector.get_zero, Vector.get_tail_succ]; rfl

C1_dependencies.name: List.Vector.get_zero
C1_dependencies.content:
@[simp]
theorem get_zero : ∀ v : Vector α n.succ, get v 0 = head v
  | ⟨_ :: _, _⟩ => rfl
